item_2_image_identities.method: Docker Hub registry v2 read-only API: one anonymous token request covering all three repos, then GET <repo>/manifests/latest (manifest bodies saved raw); the registry did not return Docker-Content-Digest headers, so each digest is COMPUTED as sha256 of the saved manifest body — identical by definition to the registry digest; config blobs (small JSON, NOT image layers) fetched to confirm architecture/os
item_2_image_identities.digest_semantics: all three repositories serve a SINGLE-PLATFORM manifest (application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json), NOT a multi-platform index; the catalog therefore pins the arm64 PLATFORM-MANIFEST digest — the same digest docker records in RepoDigests when pulling these arm64-only repositories
